predictions.rationale: The market makes Milan slight favourites (34/28/39), one of the closest lines on the card. Milan travel without nine players, among them Modrić (thigh), Camarda (ankle), Bartesaghi (tendinitis), Saelemaekers and Pavlovic, so Gonçalo Ramos is the only senior striker; Tomori is back in training. Milan are 28th on three points after three defeats in four, Olympiakos sixth on ten. The absences were public before today's prices, so the pick stays with the market, but at the lowest confidence.
predictions.disagreement: Team news leans against the favourite; no tipster consensus found.
